items.passage0: Last Friday, Kevin and I had a fight about a soccer game. He shouted at me, and I was very angry. On Saturday I felt unhappy and played alone. On Sunday, Kevin came to my house and said, "I'm sorry." We laughed and played soccer again. Our friendship is stronger now.
items.passage1: Amy had to give a speech in front of her class. She felt nervous, and her voice was very quiet. Her teacher said, "Take a deep breath and stay calm." Amy smiled at her best friend in the front row. Then she spoke slowly, and everyone clapped at the end.
items.passage2: In our farm game, every villager has different feelings about gifts. One villager is glad when you give her flowers. Another one gets angry if you give him trash! My brother is careless, so he once gave a fish to the wrong person. Now I always check what each villager likes before I give a gift.
items.passage3: A new student, Daniel, joined our class this week. At first, some kids were unfriendly to him. One boy laughed at his accent, and that was very rude. Our teacher said, "Let's welcome Daniel to our class." Now we eat lunch together, and Daniel tells the best jokes.
items.passage4: My little sister has a fear of thunder. Last night there was a big storm, and she was so afraid that she couldn't sleep. I told her jokes until she laughed. Our dog went crazy at every loud sound. In the end, we all fell asleep on the sofa.
